title: Dolly Parton’s Star-Studded Tribute Airs Tonight: How to Watch the CMA Special Online for Free
summary: The two-hour ABC special brings together generations of country stars for a night of performances, memories and tributes.
contentText:

Country music’s biggest names are coming together for one unforgettable night celebrating the life and legacy of Dolly Parton .

CMA Presents I Will Always Love You: A Celebration of Dolly Parton airs tonight, Wednesday, Oct. 21, at 9 p.m. ET on ABC and Disney+. The two-hour special brings together Reba McEntire , Carrie Underwood , Lainey Wilson , Kelsea Ballerini and more to honor the country legend, who died Aug. 25 at age 80.

Broadcast live from Belmont University’s Fisher Center for the Performing Arts in Nashville, the tribute will feature musical performances, archival footage and personal stories spanning Parton’s six-decade career. And with more than a dozen artists taking the stage, fans can expect plenty of familiar songs and a few surprises along the way.

Don’t have cable? No problem. Here’s everything you need to know about watching the Dolly Parton tribute special live online, including how to stream it for free.

At a Glance: How to Watch the Dolly Parton Tribute Special Online

- Date: Wednesday, Oct. 21

- Time: 9 p.m. ET / 6 p.m. PT

- TV Channel: ABC, Disney+

- Live Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Sling TV , Hulu + Live TV

- Watch for Free: DirecTV and Fubo free trials

- On Demand: Hulu beginning Oct. 22

If you don’t mind waiting until Thursday, Oct. 22, the special will also be available on demand through Hulu and Disney+. Standard Hulu subscriptions start at $12.49 per month, making it a more affordable option for those who don’t need to watch live.

Who Is Performing at the Dolly Parton Tribute Special?

It wouldn’t be a Dolly Parton celebration without an impressive lineup of country music royalty . Reba McEntire, Carrie Underwood, Lainey Wilson and Kelsea Ballerini are among the stars honoring the singer, alongside Brad Paisley, Carly Pearce, Darius Rucker, Ella Langley, Ashley McBryde, Little Big Town, Lady A, Vince Gill and Zac Brown.

The celebration also goes beyond country music, with appearances from Kristen Bell, Kristin Chenoweth and bluegrass musicians Béla Fleck, Molly Tuttle and Sierra Hull. Amy Grant and Kimberly Williams-Paisley will make special appearances, with additional surprise tributes expected throughout the evening.

The night will also celebrate Parton’s generosity offstage. The CMA and Belmont University will donate a portion of the event’s proceeds to Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library, the nonprofit she founded in 1995 that provides free books to children around the world.

CMA Presents I Will Always Love You: A Celebration of Dolly Parton airs tonight, Oct. 21, at 9 p.m. ET on ABC and Disney+.
